name: Curse of Aging
source_text: Discard 1 card from your hand. Decrease the ATK and DEF of all monsters on your opponent's side of the field by 500 points until the end of the turn this card is activated.
notes: Discard cost, then every opponent monster loses ATK and DEF until the end of the turn.
